common.tagline: Book by form, chat, or voice.

home.title: Voice-enabled booking
home.description: A booking platform where customers book appointments and providers manage availability by speaking — without the cost of a telephone voice agent.
home.phaseNotice: Phase 2 — providers, services and locations. The booking flow arrives in Epic 4.

auth.name: Name

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.name: Name
dashboard.inviteLinkOnce: Copy this link now — it is shown only once.
dashboard.createTenantHint: You will become its owner. The slug becomes part of your public booking address.
dashboard.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
dashboard.gatedUntilSubscribed: Providers, services, locations, availability and bookings become available once your subscription starts.
dashboard.pendingIntro: Your organization is set up and waiting for its subscription. Here is what happens next.
dashboard.stepConfigure: Add your providers, services and locations.
dashboard.stepTakeBookings: Share your booking page and start taking bookings.
dashboard.daysRemaining: {days, plural, =0 {Today is the last day to subscribe.} one {# day left to subscribe.} other {# days left to subscribe.}}
dashboard.paymentLinkSent: We have emailed the payment link to {email}. You can forward it to whoever handles payments.
dashboard.noPlansConfigured: No plans are available right now. Please contact us and we will sort it out.
dashboard.subscriptionActive: Your subscription is active — everything is unlocked.
dashboard.subscriptionEnding: Your subscription is set to end. You can restart it any time before then.
dashboard.manageBillingHint: Change your card, download invoices, or cancel. We will bring you back here afterwards.
dashboard.trialOffer: {days} days free. We take your card now but charge nothing until the trial ends, and you can cancel at any time before then.
dashboard.trialAlreadyUsed: This organization has already used its free trial, so billing starts straight away.
dashboard.trialEndsOn: Your free trial ends on {date}. We will then charge for {plan}.
dashboard.trialActive: Your trial is active — everything is unlocked.
dashboard.paymentFailedNotice: We could not take your last payment. Your service is still working, but please update your card before it stops.
dashboard.linkDiary: Link this member to a diary
dashboard.noDiaryToLink: No unlinked provider to link. Create one on the Providers screen first.
dashboard.inviteProviderElsewhere: Inviting a provider? Do it from their row on the <link>Providers</link> screen, so the invitation carries their diary.

invitation.title: Invitation
invitation.signInFirst: Sign in with the address this invitation was sent to, then open the link again.
invitation.genericError: This invitation link is not valid.
invitation.settingUpFor: Setting up your account for {email}. Choose a password and you are done.
invitation.signInAs: There is already an account for {email}. Sign in, then open this link again.

catalogue.name: Name
catalogue.slugTakenArchivedHint: That name may belong to something you archived. Tick "Show archived" and restore it instead of creating a new one.
catalogue.slugHint: Appears in your booking links. Leave blank and we will make one from the name.
catalogue.bufferHint: Minutes reserved around the appointment. Customers never see them.
catalogue.requiresApproval: Needs approval before it is confirmed
catalogue.requiresApprovalHint: Bookings arrive as requests instead of being confirmed straight away.
catalogue.inheritHint: Leave blank to inherit. Zero is different: it means bookable up to the last second.
catalogue.offeredByHint: Change who offers this on the Providers screen.
catalogue.assignOnCreateHint: Tick the services this provider offers. Assign, on their row, is where you change this later and set a duration or price that differs from the service's own.
catalogue.defaultLocationHint: Where this provider normally works. When they work — and at which location, for which service — is set by the provider on the Availability screen. Assign, on their row, adds further locations.
catalogue.createdButNotAssigned: The provider was created, but their services or location could not be linked. Use Assign on their row to finish.
catalogue.loadingAssignments: Loading this provider's services and locations…
catalogue.inheritsDuration: Leave blank to use the service's {count} min.
catalogue.priceOverrideNeedsBasePrice: This service has no set price, so there is nothing to override.
catalogue.addProviderHint: A provider is someone appointments are booked with. Giving them a login is a separate step.
catalogue.onlineBookingHint: Turn this off to keep them out of the public booking page while still taking bookings for them by phone.
catalogue.addServiceHint: Duration is what the customer sees; buffers are reserved around it and stay private.
catalogue.timezoneHint: Appointments here are shown in this zone. Leave blank to use the business's own.
catalogue.needServicesFirst: Create a service first. A provider is booked <link>for a service</link>, so one with nothing to offer cannot be booked at all.
catalogue.noLocationsYet: Assigning a <link>location</link> here says where this provider works. You have none yet — add one only if you see people in person; online and telephone appointments need none.
catalogue.assignHint: Use Assign on a provider to choose which services they offer and where they work. Until a provider is assigned at least one service, nobody can book them.
catalogue.noProviders: No providers yet. Add the first one below.
catalogue.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
catalogue.inviteIntro: We will email {email} a single-use link. They choose their own password — we never send one.
catalogue.inviteWhatTheyGet: Once they accept, this diary becomes theirs: they can set their working hours, add time off, and see their own bookings.
catalogue.inviteNeedsEmail: Providers without an email address cannot be invited. Add one on their record first.
catalogue.alreadyInvited: There is already a live invitation for this provider. Sending another will stop the first link from working.
catalogue.inviteLinkOnceHint: Only needed if the email does not arrive. Shown once — we store only a hash of it, so it cannot be recovered later.
catalogue.inviteFailed: The invitation could not be sent. Please try again.

availability.title: Availability
availability.workingHoursHint: Local times in the provider's zone. Add a second period to a day to leave a break in the middle.
availability.exceptionsHint: One-off closures and extra openings. These override the weekly hours.
availability.providerOffersNothing: This provider offers no services yet, so setting hours here will not produce any bookable times. Assign them a service on the <link>Providers</link> screen.
availability.notLinked: Your account is not linked to a provider yet. Ask an administrator to link it.
availability.skippedWarning: That time does not exist on that date — the clocks go forward. We will use the first time that does.
availability.ambiguousWarning: That time happens twice on that date — the clocks go back. We will use the earlier one.
availability.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

booking.chooseService: What would you like to book?
booking.chooseProvider: Who would you like to see?
booking.noServices: This business has nothing bookable online yet.
booking.noSlots: Nothing free on that day. Try another.
booking.contactRequired: Please leave an email address or a phone number so we can reach you.
booking.awaitingApproval: The clinic will confirm this appointment shortly.
booking.noEmailYet: Save this link — confirmation emails are not switched on yet.
booking.slotTaken: Somebody just took that time. Here are the times still free.
booking.holdExpired: Your reservation ran out. Please pick a time again.

manage.notFound: This booking link is not valid. It may have expired.

manage.notPossible: That change is not possible. Please call us.
manage.cancelWarning: This will free the time for someone else. It cannot be undone.
manage.nothingToDo: This appointment is settled and cannot be changed.

admin.signedOutHint: This area is for platform administrators. Sign in to manage organizations and their subscriptions.
admin.notAdminTitle: You do not have platform access
admin.notAdminHint: This area is for platform administrators. Your organization's own dashboard is where your work lives.
admin.platformAdminTitle: You are signed in as a platform administrator
admin.platformAdminHint: Platform administrators do not belong to any organization, so there is nothing to show here. Organizations and their subscriptions are managed on the platform dashboard.

platform.title: Platform administration
platform.subtitle: Organizations, owners and subscriptions across the whole platform.
platform.notPlatformAdmin: This area is for platform administrators.
platform.provisionExplanation: Creates the organization and emails its owner an acceptance link. You do not become a member of it.
platform.provisionFailed: The organization could not be provisioned.
platform.name: Organization name
platform.languageHint: Every email to this organization's owner, and every screen they land on, uses this.
platform.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, domain or slug
platform.loadFailed: The organizations could not be loaded.
platform.acceptLinkExplanation: Shown once and never stored. Send it to the owner, or use Resend invitation to issue a new one.
